mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate at or below 0.1% indicates an accommodative monetary policy environment that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days when the signal condition is met.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods following FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods following UNRATE increase > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate weakening demand momentum, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days due to reduced economic activity expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods following declines in both RSAFS and HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production (INDPRO > 100) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 5.0%) defines a late-cycle expansion regime where growth momentum supports positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods following INDPRO > 100 and UNRATE < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: An annualized CPI increase exceeding 2.5% signals inflationary pressure that triggers central bank tightening expectations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods following CPIAUCSL increase > 2.5% (annualized).

mechanism_narrative: Consistent monthly payroll growth above 100k persons signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods following PAYEMS growth > 100k.

mechanism_narrative: High consumer spending (RSAFS > 400,000) and strong housing starts (HOUST > 1000) define a demand expansion regime that sustains positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods following RSAFS > 400000 and HOUST > 1000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) coupled with rising unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) indicates economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods following INDPRO < 100 and UNRATE > 5.0%.
